source: Chhattisgarh Gurdwaras — OpenStreetMap (Overpass, data as of 2026-10-09T20:02:50Z), Mappls, the Gurdwara’s own page, Wikipedia
license: OpenStreetMap data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (attribution kept in each record’s sources)
method: All 33 districts (cgstate.gov.in) covered by one bounding-box search of OpenStreetMap: every place of worship, every religion=sikh object and Latin-name matches; names matched in English, Hindi and Punjabi; state and district from OSM boundaries (Nominatim). Web searches for named towns. Every record imports as "needs verification".
note: Generic map names ("Gurudwara") are labelled with the locality OpenStreetMap gives — not invented names. Unknown values stay empty.
